snippet.title: Astral Ascent - The Crimson Highlands Update
snippet.description:
The Crimson Highlands Update is now available with a new playable character, a new world to explore, new Zodiacs to face, new rooms and much more.

✧ Steam Store : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280930/Astral_Ascent/.
✧ Discord Server : http://discord.gg/hibernian-workshop
✧ Follow us on Twitter : https://twitter.com/HibernianWS

Astral Ascent is a 2D platformer rogue-lite set in a modern fantasy world. As one (or two in local co-op) of 4 Heroes with colorful personalities, you must escape from the Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful and vicious bosses—the Zodiacs!

#astralascent #roguelike #hibernianworkshop
